subject: Sponsor briefing: business priorities, risks, and procurement plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medsys.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@medsys.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, Procurement Team <procurement@medsys.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor briefing: business priorities, risks, and procurement plan

Hi Lisa / Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call with your leadership team so we have alignment and a short list of next steps for procurement and legal. I’ve bolded owners where I think we should be explicit.

Summary of business priorities (what success looks like)
- Reduce average inference latency for live clinical decision workflows to <150ms P95 across peak hours.
- Cut per-query cost by ~35% vs your current on-prem baseline through batching/caching and model selection.
- Ensure data residency and auditability for patient-identifiable logs for two years.

Top pain points you reiterated
- Unpredictable tail latency during overnight batch jobs that impacts morning reporting.
- Manual model rollout process across environments causing version drift.
- Compliance team needs a clear audit trail and KMS integration for keys.

Risks we discussed (leadership-level)
- Procurement timing: your board review for vendor selection is 6/15 — any slippage pushes pilot to Q4. (Owner: Lisa)
- Security sign-off: SOC2 evidence and KMS/HSM integration required before pilot. (Owner: Rajiv & Procurement)
- Budget constraints: finance requires a TCO comparison for Hosted vs. Dedicated by 5/20. (Owner: Soojin + Vivek)

Proposed procurement path (agreed outline)
1) SOW + Pilot proposal delivered (we will send a draft MAP attached) — Soojin by 5/10
2) Security questionnaire + SOC2 snapshot delivered — Vivek by 5/11
3) Procurement review & redlines — MedSys procurement by 5/17
4) Board decision window — target complete by 6/15

Attachments sent with this email: draft mutual action plan (MAP), SOC2 snapshot, and a short TCO sketch.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Lisa: confirm whether the board will accept a pilot-focused budget request (yes/no) by EOD 5/11.
- Rajiv / Procurement: confirm preferred routing for KMS keys (customer-managed vs. Redwood KMS) and provide necessary contact for legal redlines (procurement@medsys.com).
- I will follow up with a short one-page SOW and a cleaned MAP by Monday 5/10 (Vivek & Marissa will loop in on technical scoping).

Escalation path (if we hit procurement delays)
- Soojin -> Regional Sales Lead (Marissa Cole) -> Head of Partnerships (Vivek Kulkarni) for executive sponsor calls.

If this looks correct I’ll push the MAP and SOW drafts and schedule a 30-minute procurement workshop for 5/12 to walk legal through the redlines.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Sr. Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0129

Attachments:
- RDW_MedSys_MMAP_Draft_20270509.pdf (map)
- SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (security summary)
- mutual-action-plan-20270509.xlsx (workback)
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medsys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@medsys.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medsys.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing: business priorities, risks, and procurement plan

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear summary. This matches our internal readout. A few notes:
- Board: we have a mid-cycle review on 6/15; the CFO wants to see a clear pilot ROI and legal sign-off before that meeting. I’ll push to get the pilot budget pre-approved but can’t promise.
- Procurement: I’ve added procurement@medsys.com to this thread; they will own contract redlines. Expect a first pass by 5/17.
- Security: Rajiv, please confirm whether we can take a staged KMS approach (customer-managed keys in pilot) and whether the SOC2 snapshot is sufficient for initial review.

I’m okay with the 5/12 procurement workshop — please send calendar invite.

—Lisa
Lisa Chen
VP Product & Clinical Informatics | MedSys Health
lisa.chen@medsys.com | +1 212-555-8743
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medsys.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, procurement@medsys.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing: business priorities, risks, and procurement plan

Lisa / team —

Quick updates from the security and ops side (after reviewing the SOC2 snapshot attached):
- SOC2 snapshot: looks in line for initial pilot but we do need a short addendum describing logging retention and access controls for PHI. I can produce a 1-page addendum by EOD 5/11.
- KMS: staged approach is doable — customer-managed keys in pilot, Redwood-managed KMS for dev environments. We’ll document the HSM/KMS flow in the SOW so your security team can review. (Owner: Vivek)
- Technical scoping: Marissa and I will join the procurement workshop to walk through the integration points (API endpoints, VPC peering options, and expected P95 budgets).

Action items I’ll own:
- Deliver SOC2 addendum (1 pager) — Vivek by 5/11 (attached to this thread).
- Provide a brief TCO comparison Hosted vs Dedicated for the pilot sizing — Vivek + Marissa by 5/14.
- Draft SOW language for KMS and data residency — Marissa by 5/14.

I’ll also add notes to the HubSpot deal (link below) so procurement has visibility.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0188

Attachments:
- SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (re-attached)
- RDW_SOC2_Addendum_20270511.pdf (one-page addendum)
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@medsys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medsys.com>, procurement@medsys.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing: business priorities, risks, and procurement plan

Vivek / Soojin —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. The SOC2 addendum will help — please include explicit retention windows and the encryption-at-rest details. Procurement, please note that MedSys will expect customer-managed KMS for production; pilot can be staged as discussed.

I’m happy to join the 5/12 procurement workshop; please send the invite. Once we see the MAP + SOW we’ll run an internal legal sprint and aim to return redlines by 5/17. If that timeline slips I’ll escalate to the CIO (cc’d when needed).

Best,
Rajiv
Rajiv Menon
Head of Security & Compliance | MedSys Health
rajiv.menon@medsys.com | +1 617-555-2234
